'''Alican Kaynar''' (born 30 October 1988) is a Turkish [[yacht racing|yacht racer]] competing in the [[Finn (dinghy)|Finn]] class. The {{convert|1.91|m|ftin|abbr=on}} tall athlete at {{convert|100|kg|lb|abbr=on}} is a member of [[Fenerbahçe Sailing]], where he is coached by Mehmet Dinçay.<ref name="gsb">{{cite web |url=http://www.gsb.gov.tr/londra2012/site/sporcular.asp?nameid=446 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20121222044845/http://www.gsb.gov.tr/londra2012/site/sporcular.asp?nameid=446 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2012-12-22 |publisher=GSB |title=Türk Sporcular 2012 Londra Olimpiyatlarında-Yelken-Alican Kaynar |language=Turkish |accessdate=2012-07-10}}</ref>

Alican Kaynar is a student of [[Industrial engineering]] at the [[Bahçeşehir University]], Istanbul.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.tyf.org.tr/Content/335/2010-yili |publisher=TYF |title=2010 Yılı-Alican Kaynar |language=Turkish |accessdate=2012-07-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111102212856/http://www.tyf.org.tr/Content/335/2010-yili |archive-date=2011-11-02 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He qualified for participation at the [[Turkey at the 2012 Summer Olympics|2012 Summer Olympics]],<ref name="gsb"/> in the [[Sailing at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Finn class|Finn class]] event, he placed 18th with 154 points.<ref name="o2012">{{cite web |url=http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/sailing/finn-one-person-dinghy-heavyweight-m |website=Olympic.org |title=London 2012 Sailing, Finn - One Person Dinghy (Heavyweight) men Final |accessdate=2013-10-26}}</ref>  He competed in the same event at the [[2016 Summer Olympics|2016 Olympics]], finishing in 13th.<ref name="Rio2016">{{Cite news |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/olympics |title=Results - Finn Men - Sailing - Rio 2016 - Olympics |work=BBC Sport |access-date=2017-09-27}}</ref><ref>{{cite Sports-Reference}}</ref>
